comparison.objective: Unhook and remove an air-fryer basket, then place it safely; candidate extracts a terminal.
comparison.physical_skill: Handle/button operation and hot-surface avoidance versus precision internal-tool insertion and sustained two-tang release during wire pull.
comparison.success_condition: Requires basket on the mat, button restored, release, stillness, and no hot contact; candidate requires selective terminal removal and intact surrounding hardware. Candidate force thresholds remain absent.
comparison.reason: Large external unhooking and placement do not test recessed contact depinning.
